**Q1: Can this issue include changes to `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` (parser + stall action selection), even though scope currently lists only `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`?**
Choices:
- **A** — Yes, update both files as needed so new `check-stalls` args and `run_stall_judge` action work end-to-end **(RECOMMENDED)**
- **B** — No, modify only `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` and avoid any `orchestrate_lib.py` changes
- **C** — Keep this issue script-only; I will open a separate follow-up issue for `orchestrate_lib.py`
Reply: `Q1: A`
**Q2: For `prompts/mode-judge-stall-recovery.txt`, what should be used?**
Choices:
- **A** — Create a new prompt file in this issue, patterned after existing judge prompts **(RECOMMENDED)**
- **B** — Reuse an existing prompt file path (please specify exact file)
- **C** — Skip file creation and inline prompt text in shell script
Reply: `Q2: A`
**Q3: “Last 3 workflow run outcomes for linked PR” should be collected from which workflow set?**
Choices:
- **A** — Review/autofix workflows only (`ai-review.yml`, `internal-review.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`) **(RECOMMENDED)**
- **B** — All workflows triggered on that PR/head branch
- **C** — A fixed allowlist you provide (please name exact workflow files)
Reply: `Q3: A`
